verdict.rationale: Radar's dashboard shows dispute-rate calculations, fraud/volume trend analytics, and review-queue metrics (docs-4, docs-7, docs-19, docs-26), giving a finance lead visibility into dispute rate, review workload, and fraud trends. However, there's no explicit mention of false-positive rate tracking, approval-rate lift metrics, or a dedicated board-ready export/reporting feature. missing for 10: false-positive rate metric, approval-rate lift measurement, explicit export-to-board/CSV or reporting API for finance stakeholders, independent confirmation of dashboard analytics accuracy.
